prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE NEW SQUARE (1:1) richly detailed polished pixel-fantasy cover illustration for Core Keeper mod "Mod Options". The existing Mod Options cover inspected in context is a STYLE reference only: match its tactile fine pixel clusters, dark cave timber workshop, aged brass fittings, creamy woven lettering and restrained amber lantern light with muted teal accents. Make a fresh original composition, not an edit or replica. Three-quarter perspective, not a top-down screenshot.

Scene: cozy subterranean settings workshop. An explorer stands slightly right of center studying ONE central physical oak menu board with clear rows of brass toggle switches, modest sliders and a handful of symbolic selectable plaques. Several DISTINCT SMALL mod plaques (sprout, fishing hook, potion bottle, gear; NO text on them) arranged on a side rack are connected by thin subtly glowing teal inlaid paths to the single board, conveying discovery of compatible mods' settings in one place. Plaques remain small props, not giant floating icons. Practical joinery, metal hinges, open ledger with pictograms, shelves, tools, moss and a distant cave bridge create layered environment detail. Maintain a readable focal hierarchy and generous breathing room around title. Original richly shaded pixel textures and warm local lighting, no smooth vector UI and no photorealism.

Exact LARGE title on a dark teal cloth banner integrated upper left: "MOD OPTIONS". Exact short readable caption on a small wooden plaque below the banner: "Mod settings, in game". Use those strings verbatim. NO other readable text, version numbers or compatibility claims. Do not imply universal compatibility. No floating shield hero, no arched golden logo, no oversized slogan, no watermark. Square full-bleed PNG, polished coherent detailed pixel illustration matching the approved cover family.
visual_check: Title and exact caption correct; distinct small plaques connected to one physical toggle/slider board; original square pixel illustration; no universal compatibility claim.
